prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph on 35 mm colour-negative film, a rainy London night, shot from inside a dark first-floor office looking down through a tall window across a junction; raindrops and running streaks on the glass soften the edges of the frame while the middle stays sharp. Directly below, the front half of an ambulance roof fills the bottom of the picture, its light bar flashing blue and its yellow-green chequer gleaming wet, nose stopped at the line. A single police officer in a hi-vis jacket with blue-and-yellow chequered bands and a white helmet stands alone in the road in front of it, gloved hand raised high, one white police motorcycle with blue lights flashing parked at his side. Behind him the crossroads is entirely empty, a large dark rectangle of wet tarmac lit orange and blue, the clear centre of the composition. Very far away, at the top of the frame beyond the junction, a faint cluster of white headlights of approaching black cars, still tiny. To one side a red double-decker bus sits stopped with lit windows and a blank destination board, and other cars wait behind it. Light sources: blue strobes from the bike and the ambulance, sodium-orange street lamps, a red traffic light, the bus interior, and the dim spill of the dark office around the window frame, all reflected and doubled on the wet road, rain visible against the lamps. Teal shadows, visible film grain, halation, no readable text, plates or signs, no faces seen. Thanks.
